purpose: Temporally coherent persistent local green-cover what-if simulation
scenario_scope: Independent local grid-cell intervention beginning in 2026 and maintained through 2030.
scenario_green_formula: scenario green_mask(t) = clip(Step-28 baseline green_mask(t) + scenario increase, 0, 1)

temporal_reconstruction.hist3_std: sample standard deviation of t-1,t-2,t-3 only, ddof=1

local_neighbor_policy: Neighbouring grids remain at Step-28 baseline forecasts. green_mask_nbr_mean stays baseline; selected-grid green_mask_nbr_contrast is updated.
local_effect_formula: scenario raw anomaly - baseline raw anomaly
scenario_lst_formula: Step-28 baseline predicted LST + local anomaly delta
cooling_benefit_formula: Step-28 baseline predicted LST - scenario predicted LST
interpretation_warning: Model-based statistical sensitivity only; not causal proof or guaranteed physical cooling.
v1_relationship: V1 is retained as a direct same-year perturbation diagnostic. V2 is the preferred planning scenario because intervention history is propagated from 2026 through 2030.
